$comment: Gzip size budgets for the built landing, checked by `pnpm perf:check` after `pnpm build` (scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs). The landing ships HTML and CSS only: its JavaScript budget is 0 kB, so a script added to a page fails the check until someone raises the budget on purpose, in review (Astro writes no processed script into a page, assetsInlineLimit: 0, so one becomes a file counted here; the same check reads every built page for anything inline or from another origin, which the Content-Security-Policy refuses, is:inline scripts included). CSS: the measured build (4.9 kB, Tailwind's output for the pages) rounded up. Each project sets its own from its targets (docs/testing.md#performance-budget).

budgets.name: JavaScript (none: the pages are HTML and CSS)
